_comment: Rename to settings.json after trimming. Never commit a settings.json with literal secrets.
_mcpServers: Intentionally omitted from this template. MCP servers (GitHub/Figma/Notion/etc.) reach real external endpoints once configured with real tokens — set them up fresh on each new machine rather than carrying config across, so you consciously choose what this environment is allowed to reach and with which credentials. Add a top-level "mcpServers" object here (see Claude Code docs) only for servers this specific environment actually needs.
